verdict.rationale: Zulip's source is in a public GitHub repository that accepts code contributions (zulip-gh-1), and self-hosters get the same software as Zulip Cloud customers (zulip-docs-8). Independent community members describe it as open-sourced and '100% FOSS, unlike Mattermost and RocketChat' (zulip-comm-4, zulip-comm-8). missing for 10: first-party evidence naming the specific open-source license, documentation of licensing terms for all components.
